title: The new Productivity Puzzle and the AI structural shift

classification.rationale: The note analyses a pick-up in UK productivity growth driven by ICT and AI adoption, using PAYE and LFS data, which is a growth and activity theme with labour market and inflation implications.
classification.runner_up_reason: Employment shedding, self-employment and unit labour costs feature, but the main focus is productivity and AI-driven output per worker.
